annotations.title: Find a drug, gene or topic

description: Use this to find the type and key of what a question names (a drug, supplement or diet, a gene or protein, a biological process, a disease, a biomarker, an organism, a method or a hallmark of aging) before get_entity, list_claims or list_grants. Matches part of a name, a key or a known synonym, case-insensitive: the most-studied entity the words name exactly first, then the rest most-studied first, MeSH headings last, with how many papers involve each. Pass a result's type and key to get_entity.

cursor.description: From the last page's `pagination.next_cursor`; keep the other arguments the same.

q.description: Match on name, key or a synonym, case-insensitive substring. The most-studied entity whose name, key or synonym is exactly `q` comes first, then the rest most-studied first, and MeSH headings after them.

type.description: Entity type, e.g. intervention, gene, pathway, component, system, method, hallmark, phenotype, organism, tissue, disease, biomarker, mesh.

name: find_entities
